method: Sharpen the exact positive half-activation scalar by locating the unique derivative minimum, then combine it with an improved point-defect block bound and a signed restriction-tree telescope.
mathematical_delta: Improved the variable-rank positive point-defect endpoint from U<=5I to U<=8I/3 and proved the corresponding complete adaptive/pruned-tree retained-credit bound with common disjoint terminal cores.

case_extension.starting_class: Fixed mean -1/2 balancer towers (retained credit) and variable-rank positive point-defect towers with endpoint constant 5.
case_extension.new_class: Arbitrary-depth fresh point-defect towers with independently varying ranks r_k>=2, vanishing activation probabilities, and complete finite adaptive/pruned restriction trees.
case_extension.prior_constant: 5 for the positive point-defect endpoint; no retained-tree statement recorded for that family
case_extension.new_constant: 8/3 for both endpoint and retained tree loss; H/I constant 22/3

remaining_obstacle: The positive restriction-mean floor and fresh-disjoint tensorization do not survive biased selectors, sign-flipped point defects, or changing overlapping cores.
next_action: Test one biased-selector or sign-flipped point-defect recurrence and identify a replacement for the lost positive mean floor; do not optimize the present scalar constant again.
